notes.subject: ואשא את עיני
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'lift my eyes' = look; Tok Pisin 'raunim ol ai bilong mi' keeps the bodily motion.

notes.subject: foapela kon
notes.rationale: Vision begins with a count of four horns, matched by four craftsmen in v3.

notes.subject: kon
notes.rationale: The horns are an unexplained vision symbol; their meaning is withheld until v2.

translation: Na mi raunim ⟨את⟩ ol ai bilong mi, na mi lukim, na long lukim i no long lukim — foapela kon i stap.

tokens.gloss: na long lukim i no long lukim
